purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) system for Japanese medical billing. It generates monthly summary/aggregate reports (社保・総括表) for medical insurance claims, handling both outpatient and inpatient cases (HCM2I/HCM2J/HCM2S/HCM2T data). It processes insurance number data, prints formatted reports with counts, days, points, and meal/food therapy costs broken down by insurance category.
purpose.domain: healthcare/medical billing (Japanese national health insurance claims processing)

verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 but contains Japanese text (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS), causing mojibake in comments. The 'grpsys' prefix on two lines appears to be a special preprocessor or group-system marker used in the ORCA build system. Commented-out COPY lines (with *****) show version evolution of included record layouts. The program is clearly production medical billing software from the Japanese JMA ORCA open-source project.
